name: oracle-firefox
description: Consult ChatGPT and continue existing conversations automatically through an installed Firefox browser using WebDriver BiDi.

interface.shortDescription: Consult ChatGPT through Firefox without Chrome.
interface.longDescription: Oracle Firefox gives Codex a local, Firefox-native second-opinion workflow. It can start a consultation with selected source files or continue one exact existing ChatGPT conversation, using a dedicated persistent Firefox profile and confirmed terminal response capture.
defaultPrompt: Get a Firefox-backed second opinion on this code.
Ask ChatGPT to review these files through Firefox.
Continue an existing ChatGPT conversation through Firefox.
